pages.quiz:
BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   B. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   D. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

6. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   B. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   C. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   C. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.
   C. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

11. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   B. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.

12. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer and Investor Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Regulators in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Planning and Development in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. B — Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. A — Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain symbols used on a map

6. D — Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. C — Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A — Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. B — Plan income and spending wisely

10. B — Nairobi

11. B — Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Consumer and Investor Protection; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Financial Regulators in Business; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Economic Planning and Development in Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of International Trade; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
